svg.metadata: {"id": "s049", "name": "天文台星空", "cat": "科学", "tags": ["科学", "天文", "星座", "夜晚"], "desc": "晴朗星空下的天文台：银河斜贯夜空，北斗七星与北极星连线，弯月、流星，山丘上圆顶天文台开着观测缝，近处一架望远镜。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [520, 1300]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "milkyway", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "stars", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.3, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "big_dipper", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.6, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "moon", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "meteor", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "hills_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "hills_near", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "observatory", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "window_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "telescope", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "fireflies", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#1D2453", "sky2": "#353B82", "sky3": "#7B66B4", "horizon": "#F4A8A6", "star": "#FFFFFF", "star2": "#FFE9A8", "milky": "#C9C3FF", "moon": "#FFF0C4", "hill1": "#56689E", "hill2": "#3F5389", "hill3": "#2E4272", "dome": "#E8EEF6", "dome2": "#C3CEDD", "wall": "#D3DCE8", "slit": "#262B57", "scope": "#5C6A8C", "scope2": "#A1ADC8", "glow": "#FFD98A", "line": "#C8D0FF", "tree": "#1E2C50", "meteor": "#FFFFFF"}}
